ORDER (08.12.2023) The petitioner whose property has come under acquisition undertaken under the National Highways Act, 1956 in the form of Award no. Coll/Def/2021/124-25 dated 26.04.2021 passed by the Collector Land Acquisition Defence, Rajouri- Poonch, HQ Rajouri, being dissatisfied with the quantum of compensation assessed approached the competent authority by an application in terms of sub section 5 of 3-G but the petitioner is finding that the matter is not being referred to arbitrator for adjudication under sub section 6 of 3-G and, accordingly, the present writ petition.
